# Flightdeck Consulting

> Expert airline pilot and flight attendant interview preparation coaching with 19 years of recruitment industry insight, led by Sasha Robinson.

Flightdeck Consulting specializes in helping aspiring pilots and cabin crew prepare for airline interviews through personalized coaching, comprehensive workbooks, simulator training, and video guidance. Based in Sydney, Australia, the company draws on deep experience with major carriers including Qantas, Cathay Pacific, Emirates, and Virgin.

## Key Topics

- Airline pilot interview preparation
- Interview coaching
- Pilot recruitment
- Flight attendant interviews
- Sasha Robinson
- Interview workbooks
- Simulator assessment training
- Behavioral interview techniques

- Career guidance
- One-on-one coaching
- B737NG flight simulator
- Cabin crew preparation

## Core Services & Products

- [Airline Pilot Interview Preparation](https://www.flightdeckconsulting.com/airline-pilot-interview-preparation): Comprehensive airline pilot interview preparation guide covering behavioral and technical topics
- [Complete Airline Pilot Interview Workbook](https://www.flightdeckconsulting.com/airline-pilot-interview-preparation-book): Complete Airline Pilot Interview Workbook by Sasha Robinson: structured answer preparation
- [Interview Coaching Package (Two 90 min sessions)](https://www.flightdeckconsulting.com/shop/one-on-one-interview-coaching): One-on-one interview coaching package: two 90-minute personalized sessions with Sasha Robinson
- [Flight Simulator Assessment Training](https://www.flightdeckconsulting.com/shop/simulator-assessment-training): B737NG flight simulator assessment training at Sydney Flight College, Bankstown Airport
- [Complete Flight Attendant Interview Workbook](https://www.flightdeckconsulting.com/shop/the-complete-flight-attendant-interview-work-book): Complete Flight Attendant Interview Workbook: instant download cabin crew interview prep
- [Products & Services Overview](https://www.flightdeckconsulting.com/products-services): Flightdeck Consulting products: workbooks, software, aptitude tests, coaching packages

## Interview Preparation Resources
